question: Can independent Codex and Claude reviews assign stable, generalizable architectural root classes to real findings well enough for deterministic recurrence detection to be useful?

A.pairDecisionSource: Exact equality after frozen formatting-only root-class normalization.

B.pairDecisionSource: Explicit reviewer pair decisions; raw-label replay remains separately measured.

independence: Each reviewer-condition invocation starts a new non-persistent session.
Each invocation runs in a separate temporary directory containing no repository or gold files.
Only the frozen condition prompt and response schema are supplied.
No reviewer output is shown to another reviewer before all four raw outputs are frozen.
normalization: Unicode NFKC; trim; uppercase; replace each non-alphanumeric run with underscore; trim outer underscores. No semantic alias mapping.

metrics.exactNormalizedRootClassAgreement: Fraction of corpus findings with equal normalized labels across reviewers.
metrics.pairwisePositiveClass: SAME_ROOT; gold AMBIGUOUS pairs excluded from precision/recall/F1 and checkpoint error denominators.
metrics.pairwisePrecisionRecallF1: Binary metrics with reviewer AMBIGUOUS treated as not-SAME.
metrics.interReviewerPairwiseAgreement: Raw exact decision agreement across non-gold-AMBIGUOUS pairs; reviewer AMBIGUOUS remains a distinct decision and therefore agrees only with AMBIGUOUS.
metrics.falseCheckpointRate: Gold DIFFERENT_ROOT pairs that activate the Run 1 checkpoint divided by all gold DIFFERENT_ROOT pairs.
metrics.missedCheckpointRate: Gold SAME_ROOT pairs that do not activate the Run 1 checkpoint divided by all gold SAME_ROOT pairs.
metrics.ambiguousCaseRate: Reviewer AMBIGUOUS decisions divided by all designated pairs.
metrics.replaySequence: left finding@SHA1; left-class remediation@SHA2; right finding@SHA3; right-class remediation@SHA4; left manifestation@SHA5. The unchanged Run 1 projector checkpoints iff supplied recurrence identity is shared.
metrics.errorTaxonomy: Naming disagreement means explicit SAME_ROOT but unequal normalized labels; substantive disagreement means explicit pair decision differs from non-ambiguous gold.

decisionRule.A: EXTENSION_SUFFICIENT_WITH_EXPLICIT_CLASSES only if Condition A raw-label replay and pair metrics pass every threshold for both reviewers, inter-reviewer pair agreement passes, and exact normalized item-label agreement is at least 0.80.
decisionRule.B: Otherwise EXTENSION_SUFFICIENT_WITH_RUBRIC_OR_HUMAN_GATE only if Condition B explicit pair metrics pass checkpoint thresholds for both reviewers, explicit inter-reviewer agreement passes, and decision-gated replay through the unchanged projector passes.
decisionRule.D: CORE_HOOK_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED only if execution reveals a concrete capability unavailable through existing extension/session surfaces; classification error alone cannot select D.

executionNotes: An initial no-output invocation was rejected by both CLIs before inference because the frozen JSON Schemas used unsupported draft/const syntax. The schemas were compatibility-adjusted without changing fields, prompts, metrics, gold, or model selectors; failed command artifacts are preserved under results/failed-attempt-0.
